title: BOARD RESOLUTION — ADOPTION OF THE SOVEREIGN STACK GOVERNANCE FRAMEWORK

body.text: WHEREAS, P31 Labs, Inc. is a Georgia domestic nonprofit corporation (EIN 42-1888158) incorporated on April 3, 2026 under O.C.G.A. Title 14, Chapter 3; and
WHEREAS, the Board is committed to transparent, auditable governance of the software systems operated for the benefit of the organization and its users; and

WHEREAS, the Engineering team has developed the Sovereign Stack governance framework — a machine-readable constitution system covering the design, monetization, justice, audit, and runtime domains, with tamper-evident audit trails and gate-level enforcement; and
WHEREAS, the framework ensures every gate can prove it can fail, every action is recorded on a hash-chained ledger, and no single party can sever any governed domain; and
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Board hereby adopts the Sovereign Stack governance framework as the official governance framework for the P31 Labs software stack, effective immediately; and

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Board directs the Engineering team to maintain the governance framework as the single source of truth for system governance, and to keep the enterprise constitution, compliance mapping, evidence register, and known-gaps ledger current; and

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Board acknowledges the framework's disclosed boundaries — including the current local-only state of the monetization and justice debt-count ratchets, and the absence of an external compliance certification — and directs that these be reported to the Board on a fixed cadence until closed; and
FURTHER RESOLVED, that the President is authorized to publish the governance framework documentation to partners, auditors, and regulators as the organization's governance disclosure.
